source_title: A macho Mexican superstar sings songs full of emotion

Carin Leon performs during "De Sonora Para El Mundo Tour" at Nu Stadium on June 28, 2026 in Miami, Florida. John Parra/Getty Images hide caption
With his crooked cowboy hat, thick black beard and oversized belt buckles, Carín León looks every bit the macho Mexican superstar singer that he is. But beneath the swagger is a romantic with a talent for heartbreak. Proving that even the toughest hombres have a soft spot and a song for every wound. We go to Leon’s hometown of Hermosillo, Sonora to meet the singer. Support public media with NPR+ and enjoy perks for over 25 podcasts like this one. This show’s perks include sponsor-free listening.
